templates.name: SourceAnt
templates.description: AI pull request review and persistent memory for coding agents
templates.content:
name: ${NAME}
services:
  agent:
    image: ghcr.io/sourceant/sourceant:latest
    container_name: ${NAME}
    environment:
      APP_ENV: production
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://sourceant:${DB_PASSWORD}@db:5432/sourceant
      LLM_MODEL: ${LLM_MODEL}
      GEMINI_API_KEY: ${GEMINI_API_KEY}
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      QUEUE_MODE: redis
      LOG_DRIVER: console
    expose:
      - "8000"
    networks:
      - default
      - proxy
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: ${NAME}-db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: sourceant
      POSTGRES_USER: sourceant
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "sourceant"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
    volumes:
      - ./data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
  redis:
    image: redis:7.2
    container_name: ${NAME}-redis
    volumes:
      - ./data/redis:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
  memgraph:
    image: memgraph/memgraph:3.11.0
    container_name: ${NAME}-memgraph
    command: ["--data-directory=/var/lib/memgraph-data/db"]
    volumes:
      - ./data/memgraph:/var/lib/memgraph-data
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true

templates.name: Trakli
templates.description: Personal finance tracker for wallets, transactions and budgets
templates.content:
name: ${NAME}
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/trakli/webservice:latest
    container_name: ${NAME}
    command: ["sh", "-c", "php artisan migrate --force && exec frankenphp run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile"]
    environment: &trakli
      APP_NAME: Trakli
      APP_ENV: production
      APP_KEY: ${APP_KEY}
      APP_URL: ${APP_URL}
      DB_CONNECTION: mysql
      DB_HOST: mysql
      DB_PORT: "3306"
      DB_DATABASE: trakli
      DB_USERNAME: trakli
      DB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      CACHE_STORE: database
      SESSION_DRIVER: database
      QUEUE_CONNECTION: database
    volumes:
      - ./storage:/var/www/html/storage
    expose:
      - "80"
    networks:
      - default
      - proxy
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
  worker:
    image: ghcr.io/trakli/webservice:latest
    container_name: ${NAME}-worker
    command: php artisan queue:work --tries=3 --timeout=120
    environment: *trakli
    volumes:
      - ./storage:/var/www/html/storage
    depends_on:
      app:
        condition: service_started
    restart: unless-stopped
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: ${NAME}-mysql
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: trakli
      MYSQL_USER: trakli
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "127.0.0.1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
    volumes:
      - ./data/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
